name: RotaryMul

y.description: Output tensor with rotary position embedding applied, same shape and dtype as input

description: Rotary Position Embedding multiplication. torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul(input, r1, r2, rotary_mode) applies rotary transform. Pure PyTorch: if rotary_mode=='half', split input into halves and compute x*r1 + rotated(x)*r2; if rotary_mode=='interleave', split by even/odd indices. Supports float16, bfloat16, float32.
